infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SwingVision Clone needs access to the camera to record your tennis matches and analyze your shots.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SwingVision Clone needs access to the microphone to record audio with your match videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SwingVision Clone needs access to your photo library to save and share match recordings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: SwingVision Clone needs permission to save match videos to your photo library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SwingVision Clone to access your camera to record matches.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SwingVision Clone to access your microphone for video recording.
